Lands' End: Quality Clothing, Apparel, Swimwear and Footwear

Summer has a way of slowing everything down to the best possible pace. Long afternoons by the water, cookouts that stretch past sundown, neighborhood block parties where nobody checks the clock. At Lands' End, we build our summer collections around those real-life moments, so your family can soak up every golden hour in clothing that feels as good as the season itself.

From early-morning beach trips to late-night porch conversations, our summer pieces blend easygoing comfort with lasting quality. We designed this season's lineup to keep up with full days and busy evenings alike, so you can focus on the fun and leave the fuss behind.

Read More Read Less

Summer Clothing for Every Wardrobe

Summer fills up fast with plans you didn't see coming and traditions you look forward to all year. Our summer collections for women, men and kids are built around that energy, blending relaxed fits with polished details that work from sunup to well past dark. Wherever the day takes your family, Lands' End has the pieces to keep everyone comfortable and looking great.

Everyday Summer Looks for Women

The Lands' End women's clothing collection captures that effortless summer feeling in feel‑good fabrics you'll reach for again and again. Imagine browsing a coastal boardwalk in a flowing linen dress that breathes with the afternoon breeze, or meeting friends for dinner in a soft knit top paired with relaxed-fit chinos.

For busier days, lightweight tees and classic button-front shirts pair naturally with structured shorts or cropped pants for a look that stays polished without trying too hard. From sunrise yoga to Saturday evening gatherings, you'll find updated prints, warm-weather palettes and flattering silhouettes that turn ordinary days into standout ones.

Men's Styles That Keep Up with Summer

Crafted for the rhythm of summer, the Lands' End men's clothing collection keeps pace from early tee times to easy evening hangouts on the deck. Breathable linen shirts and moisture-wicking polos stay cool under the hottest afternoon sun, while our tailored-fit shorts and lightweight chinos bring just enough polish for impromptu dinner plans.

For low-key weekends, soft cotton tees and laid-back knit polos handle everything from Saturday farmers' market runs to afternoons spent grilling with the neighbors. These are the kind of reliable summer staples that feel right every time you put them on.

Kids' Styles for Sunshine and Playtime

Summer means freedom for kids, and their wardrobes should keep that same spirit alive. The kids' clothing collection from Lands' End delivers comfort and durability built for boundless energy, messy treats and all-day play.

Soft graphic tees in eye-catching colors hold up to long days of playground tag and backyard camping. Easy-on dresses with playful prints look just as cute at a Fourth of July picnic as they do on a family road trip. Quick-dry shorts give kids total freedom to jump in the water one more time, and head straight to a patio lunch or dinner. Every piece is made to handle real kid adventures while still looking great in family photos.

Make a Splash in Swimwear for Every Moment

Nothing says summer quite like that first jump into the pool or a barefoot walk along the shoreline. At Lands' End, our swimwear collections are designed around all those sun-soaked hours by the water, giving your whole family pieces that look great and hold up splash after splash.

Thoughtfully Designed Swimwear for Women

Designed for every way you enjoy the water, the Lands' End women's swimwear collection brings a range of styles that fit the moment. Sleek one-pieces, vibrant bikinis and versatile tankinis all feature thoughtful construction that balances flattering coverage with easy movement. Spend a morning doing laps, then lounge poolside for the rest of the afternoon without reaching for a different suit.

Rash guards and swim skirts add coverage for longer days in the sun, while bold tropical prints and timeless solids let your personality lead the way. Many of our styles include built-in UPF protection, so you can stay out longer without worrying about overexposure.

Men's Swim Styles That Keep Up All Summer

Designed for every summer water moment, the Lands' End men's swimwear collection keeps up from neighborhood pool games to hours at the lake. Classic swim trunks and board shorts come in multiple lengths, each built with adjustable waistbands for a secure, personalized fit.

Standout prints pair well with laid-back solids, so finding your personal look comes easy. Quick-dry fabrics let you go straight from a swim to a beachside lunch without sitting around in wet clothes. Built-in UPF protection and chlorine-resistant construction keep these pieces performing all season long.

Kids' Swimwear for Every Water Adventure

Kids live for the water in summertime, and their swimwear should match that enthusiasm. Our boys' and girls' swim collections feature bold colors, playful patterns and comfortable fits that hold up through hours of cannonballs and sandcastle construction.

Quick-dry board shorts and swim trunks for boys get them back in the action fast, while girls can pick from one-pieces and swim separates made for handstands in the shallow end or cartwheels on the beach. Rash guards with UPF 50 protection keep them covered during all-day pool sessions, so the only thing they need to think about is having a good time.

The SlenderSuit and Tugless Swimwear Collections

The SlenderSuit® Collection uses exclusive Slendertex® fabric with built-in shaping panels that sculpt and smooth your silhouette without feeling restrictive. Options like tummy control and curve-flattering fits make these suits a favorite for days when you want to look and feel your absolute best by the water.

Known for its fuss free, stay put fit, the Tugless® Collection has become a favorite for swimming, lounging and all-day water wear. Wide straps, secure construction and smooth finishes mean you spend your time enjoying the water instead of adjusting your suit. Both collections pair timeless style with smart, practical design.

Lightweight Summer Outerwear

Warm summer days have a habit of turning into cool evenings faster than you'd expect. That's why Lands' End offers lightweight summer outerwear that layers in seamlessly when the temperature drops.

A packable jacket tucks into a bag for lakeside picnics or spontaneous rainy-afternoon plans, while a zip-up hoodie adds just enough warmth for stargazing or late-night s'mores. For a more polished option, our windbreakers bring a clean look to evening walks or outdoor concerts.

Quality fabrics and functional details keep you prepared for shifting temperatures without adding bulk. Go ahead and stay out for one more sunset. We've got the layers to keep you comfortable.

Summer Fits for Every Body Type

At Lands' End, we know that great clothing starts with a great fit. That's why we offer sizing built around real body proportions, so everyone in the family can enjoy summer in pieces that feel made for them. Our regular sizes provide a reliable, go-to fit for everyday wear. Plus-size options bring the same style and ease in cuts designed to flatter fuller figures.

We also pay close attention to smaller proportions. Our petite sizes are tailored for smaller frames, so nothing feels oversized or overwhelming. Our tall sizes feature thoughtful adjustments for longer torsos and extended inseams. With this kind of sizing commitment, Lands' End makes sure nobody has to compromise fit to get the summer wardrobe they want.

Comfortable Shoes for Every Summer Adventure

From breezy sunny-day style to cool looks under the evening stars, start with our dazzling array of Women's Shoes. Shop comfortable everyday shoes, casual sneakers, lightweight slip-ons, flats, and spring and summer footwear that pairs effortlessly with everything from shorts and sundresses to flowy skirts and other warm-weather staples. If your plans include sand, surf or poolside lounging, our Women's Sandals & Water Shoes are ready to take the trip with you. Our plush and comfortable women's sandals, supportive footbeds and water-friendly shoes dry quickly and transition easily from beach to boardwalk.

From a casual backyard barbecue to a fancy summer soiree, guys have plenty of footwear options with our complete selection of Men's Shoes. Lands' End men's footwear is made for comfort and durability in those carefree warm-weather months. Treat your feet to everyday sneakers for walking, hiking, travel and just hanging out. For beach trips, boat days and poolside adventures, shop Men's Sandals & Water Shoes for men's summer sandals and quick-dry water shoes designed to handle wet surfaces and long, fun-filled days in the great outdoors. If you want men's spring and summer shoes that feel good, look great and step up to any activity, Lands' End is like that good friend you can always count on.

Kids can stay ready for every adventure with breathable, comfortable styles from Kids' Shoes, perfect for playdates, family vacations and everyday summer fun. When it's time for splash pads, beach days and playing by the pool, choose Kids' Sandals & Water Shoes for quick-drying, summer-ready footwear that helps kids stay comfortable in and out of the water. Wherever spring and summer take you, Lands' End shoes, sandals and water shoes help kids soak up the season in comfort and style.

Experience the Lands' End Difference: Quality, Care and a Commitment to You

Choosing Lands' End means choosing a brand built on integrity, lasting quality and genuine care for every customer. We take pride in recognition for outstanding service, but what drives us goes deeper than any award. It's a commitment to listening, to putting you first and to creating pieces your family will reach for all summer long and far beyond. When you shop with Lands' End, you join a community that values your trust and works every day to earn it.
